prompt:
You are checking which candidate answer correctly answers a question about a SQL database.

Question:
Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH driver_participation AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        year,
        first_round,
        last_round,
        constructor_id
    FROM drives
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
driver_first_race AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        year,
        MIN(first_round) as first_round_num
    FROM driver_participation
    GROUP BY driver_id, year
),
driver_last_race AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        year,
        MAX(last_round) as last_round_num
    FROM driver_participation
    GROUP BY driver_id, year
),
first_race_details AS (
    SELECT 
        dp.driver_id,
        dp.year,
        dp.first_round as first_round_num,
        dp.constructor_id as first_constructor_id
    FROM driver_participation dp
    JOIN driver_first_race df ON dp.driver_id = df.driver_id AND dp.year = df.year AND dp.first_round = df.first_round_num
),
last_race_details AS (
    SELECT 
        dp.driver_id,
        dp.year,
        dp.last_round as last_round_num,
        dp.constructor_id as last_constructor_id
    FROM driver_participation dp
    JOIN driver_last_race dl ON dp.driver_id = dl.driver_id AND dp.year = dl.year AND dp.last_round = dl.last_round_num
)
SELECT 
    frd.driver_id,
    frd.year,
    frd.first_round_num,
    lrd.last_round_num,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    c.name as constructor_name
FROM first_race_details frd
JOIN last_race_details lrd ON frd.driver_id = lrd.driver_id AND frd.year = lrd.year
JOIN drivers d ON frd.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOI

[B]
SQL:
WITH driver_seasons AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        year,
        constructor_id,
        first_round,
        last_round,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driver_id, year ORDER BY first_round) as rn_first,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driver_id, year ORDER BY last_round DESC) as rn_last
    FROM drives
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_drives AS (
    SELECT driver_id, year, constructor_id as first_constructor, first_round as first_round_id, last_round as last_round_id
    FROM driver_seasons
    WHERE rn_first = 1
),
last_drives AS (
    SELECT driver_id, year, constructor_id as last_constructor, first_round as first_round_id, last_round as last_round_id
    FROM driver_seasons
    WHERE rn_last = 1
),
driver_race_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT first_round) as distinct_rounds
    FROM drives
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY driver_id, year
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    fs.driver_id,
    fs.year,
    fs.first_constructor,
    fs.first_round_id,
    fs.last_round_id,
    drc.distinct_rounds
FROM first_drives fs
JOIN last_drives ld ON fs.driver_id = ld.driver_id AND fs.year = ld.year
JOIN driver_race_counts drc ON fs.driver_id = drc.driver_id AND fs.year = drc.year
WHERE fs.first_constructor = ld.last_constructor
  AND fs.first_round_id < fs.last_round_id
  AND drc.distinct_rounds >= 2
ORDER BY fs.driver_id, fs.year

[D]
SQL:
WITH season_info AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        MIN(first_round) as min_round,
        MAX(last_round) as max_round
    FROM drives
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
constructor_at_round AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.year,
        d.driver_id,
        d.first_round,
        d.last_round,
        d.constructor_id
    FROM drives d
    WHERE d.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_last_constructor AS (
    SELECT 
        si.year,
        si.driver_id,
        c1.constructor_id as first_constructor,
        c2.constructor_id as last_constructor,
        si.min_round,
        si.max_round
    FROM season_info si
    JOIN constructor_at_round c1 ON si.year = c1.year AND si.driver_id = c1.driver_id
        AND c1.first_round = si.min_round
    JOIN constructor_at_round c2 ON si.year = c2.year AND si.driver_id = c2.driver_id
        AND c2.last_round = si.max_round
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        first_constructor,
        last_constructor,
        min_round,
        max_round,
        max_round - min_round + 1 as rounds_span
    FROM first_last_constructor
    WHERE first_constructor = last_constructor
      AND rounds_span >= 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id, first_constructor, min_round, max_round, rounds_span
FROM qualified
ORDER BY year, driver_id
